_note: School of Sport container context pack for finding-using-sources-advanced. It frames the academic-practice skill for a whole academic School of Sport (sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, strength & conditioning), drawing worked examples from across those subjects and varying the subject lesson to lesson, rather than from one discipline. There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark document; subject.scheme, subject.code and subject.benchmarkId are therefore empty and context.label is "sport" so {{context}} tokens resolve to "sport".
